headline_marked: Haaland's double as [[Norway reach World Cup knockouts]] after 28 years
headline: Haaland's double as Norway reach World Cup knockouts after 28 years
summary: Erling Haaland scored twice in a 3-2 victory over Senegal in New Jersey to secure Norway's place in the final 32.
details: Erling Haaland scored two goals in Norway's 3-2 win over Senegal on Monday, booking a place for his team in the knockout round in their first World Cup appearance for 28 years.

The 25-year-old Haaland now has four goals in just two matches at this World Cup. Norway's first goal came from substitute Marcus Pedersen after a misjudged clearance by Senegal captain Kalidou Koulibaly.

In the second half, Martin Odegaard provided a classic assist for Haaland's first goal, which he rifled into the top corner. Haaland then added a second ten minutes later with a volley off the crossbar.
Senegal's Ismaila Sarr scored twice, including a goal in stoppage time, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Norwegian lead.
Norway and France have both secured their places in the final 32 of Group I. The two teams will face each other on Friday to decide who tops the group.
The match took place in New Jersey amidst heavy rain and thunderstorms. Norway fans celebrated the victory with a 'Viking row' on the pitch.
caption:
Norway is back in the World Cup knockouts for the first time in 28 years! 🇳🇴

Erling Haaland scored two goals in Norway's 3-2 win over Senegal on Monday, booking a place for his team in the knockout round in their first World Cup appearance for 28 years.

The 25-year-old Haaland now has four goals in just two matches at this World Cup. Norway's first goal came from substitute Marcus Pedersen after a misjudged clearance by Senegal captain Kalidou Koulibaly.

In the second half, Martin Odegaard provided a classic assist for Haaland's first goal, which he rifled into the top corner. Haaland then added a second ten minutes later with a volley off the crossbar.

Senegal's Ismaila Sarr scored twice, including a goal in stoppage time, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Norwegian lead.

Norway and France have both secured their places in the final 32 of Group I. The two teams will face each other on Friday to decide who tops the group.

The match took place in New Jersey amidst heavy rain and thunderstorms. Norway fans celebrated the victory with a 'Viking row' on the pitch.

headline: Bangladeshi vessel ‘Banglar Joyjatra’ crosses Strait of Hormuz
summary: The ship has successfully navigated one of the world's most strategic maritime corridors after a period of tension.
details: The Bangladeshi vessel 'Banglar Joyjatra' has successfully crossed the Strait of Hormuz, a critical maritime choke point connecting the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
caption:
A Bangladeshi ship has successfully navigated the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most strategic and tense maritime corridors.

The Bangladeshi vessel 'Banglar Joyjatra' has successfully crossed the Strait of Hormuz, a critical maritime choke point connecting the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
